title: Waay more crops and food
description: Adds more crops and food to the game
body:
There are some things you should know about this mod.
- This Mod is in heavy develeopment and everything can change.
- I am not a professional.
- This Mod is still in testing. Not all features will work.
- This Mod is made with Mcreator  [https://mcreator.net](https://mcreator.net)


This Mod tries to add new plants, crops, tomatoes, corn, and new carrot sorts.
I will try to keep everything realistic. My goal for the future is to get you a completely working mod that you like so write in the comment section what you like and what not so I can improve.


You should download this Mod if you don´t like the variations of plants in minecraft. Or you are part of a minecraft server that uses this mod (like mine)
